findings.message: Tests are present but failing/unverified: no build record was supplied, so their pass-state cannot be confirmed. A text search of the test files shows the tests exist: owningTypecheckProjects is asserted at validation-checks.test.ts:157; withTypecheckProjects (and through it changedFiles) at :169-197; runTypechecks/runOne through runValidationChecks with typecheckProjects at :206-229; and the runValidateSession wiring through handleBuildStep at build-step.test.ts:1664-1671. No not-exercised gap is reported; run the suite to confirm these pass.
